# freshdesk_custom_object_record (Resource)

One record of a custom object.

-> Custom objects require a plan that enables the feature. Accounts without it answer `403` on these endpoints.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (Map of String) Field values keyed by field name. Non-string values are given as JSON, for example `"42"` or `"true"`.
- `schema_id` (String) ID of the custom object schema. Changing it forces a new record.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the record was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Display identifier Freshdesk assigned to the record, for example `BKG-1`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the record was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import as <schema_id>:<record_display_id>.
terraform import freshdesk_custom_object_record.example CO_123:BKG-1
```
